n: ASU Makey Makey Native American regions interactive poster
t: A 4th grade lesson where students build a touch poster about Native American regions.
steps: Find the lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Open the linked Google Slides lesson plan.
Buy a Makey Makey for each group.
Set up a computer with Scratch and a microphone.
Gather poster materials and foil or other conductive items.
Test one touch point before class.
Plan how groups will cover ten regions with the available inputs.
